rows.en: (So the weather still hasn't cleared up...)
(So the weather still hasn't cleared up...)
(So the weather still hasn't cleared up...)
(So the weather still hasn't cleared up...)
Something's wrong...!! Rider 1 and Rider 2 are gone...!!
The Kamen Riders are gone!? That's strange...
Something's wrong...!! Our seniors, Rider 1 and Rider 2, are gone...!!
That's weird... Rider 1 and Rider 2 are gone...
Something's wrong... Rider 1 and Rider 2 are gone...
There aren't any Kamen Riders here at all... This is supposed to be the place, isn't it...?
Huh? Rider 1 and Rider 2 ain't even here...
The frozen Kamen Rider 1 and Kamen Rider 2 had vanished.
There was no sign that the ice had melted.
In their place stood an unfamiliar device.
What the...? What is that...?
It looks like some kind of gate.
It looks like some kind of gate.
It looks like some kind of gate.
Looks like some kind of gate.
Looks like some kind of gate.
It looks like some kind of gate.
Looks kinda like a gate.
Obtained Accel's chip.
Obtained Trial's chip.
Obtained Methuss's chip.
Obtained Hikari's chip.
Obtained Ankh's chip.
Obtained Momotaros's chip.
Obtained Urataros's chip.
Obtained Kintaros's chip.
You bastards... You chased me all the way here? You're a persistent bunch!!
I'll deal with you plenty later!! You'll pay for this!!
Would you like to view the tutorial on chips?
You can view tutorials at any time from the Camp Menu.
Would you like to view the tutorial on checkpoints?
You can view tutorials at any time from the Camp Menu.
Seamons's corpse lies here.
...!? You guys...!!
OOO!! You were here too!!
Yes.
OOO, do you know him?
Let me introduce you. This is Kamen Rider W (Double).
Just call me W. Nice to meet you.
I see, W. I'm Nu Gundam. Good to meet you.
I'm Ultraman Zero. Nice to meet ya!
Yeah, likewise!!
Getting right to it, W: if you know anything about this world, I'd like you to tell us.
Let's see... That giant windmill you can see over there is a dead ringer for "Fuuto Tower"...
Fuuto Tower?
It's a building that's kind of the symbol of "Fuuto," the city where we lived.
So you're saying this place is that Fuuto?
Nah, the streets look pretty different. Plus, it's creepy that there's no wind blowing.
Fuuto means "Wind City," and true to its name, the wind blows there all year round.
I see...
W, we plan to explore for a while. Would you come with us?
Sure, I don't mind, but are the other two okay with that?
You bet we are!!
Riders help each other out, right!?
Okay! Got it. Let's join forces and get moving!!
Kamen Rider W joined the party!
Allow me to say it as well: nice to meet you.
Who's that? Is there another one of you?
Ah, sorry, sorry. This is my partner, Philip.
Shotaro, that doesn't explain anything.
What do you mean?
The two of us are one Kamen Rider.
So you mean you look like one person, but there are two minds inside?
Yeah, yeah, that's it.
Well, to be precise...
Philip, skip the complicated stuff. That's more or less how it is, so nice to meet you!
...Well, this world's full of stuff I don't know. Nothing that shows up is gonna surprise me.
I'm Ultraman Zero. Nice to meet ya.
What is this place...? The atmosphere's different from before.
Looks like we got teleported here in an instant.
What do we do, Ankh?
How the hell should I know?
Whatever. We're gonna walk around and look.
These ruins... Doesn't look like this is Fuuto.

notes.note: 0147 #0.3-0.6 are party-variant copies of the same thought line (Weather Dopant stole the wind earlier); rendered as a realization, not a question.

OOO calls them '1-go senpai / 2-go senpai' (respect for senior Riders). Rendered 'Our seniors, Rider 1 and Rider 2' rather than a Sempai honorific (glossary 'Sempai' is for Imagin addressing Momotaros).
Source has a typo (a kanji meaning 'indignant' instead of 'accustomed'); read as 'unfamiliar device'.
Chip rows 0.21-0.28: the game's character chips. 0.22 says only 'Trial' (not 'Accel Trial'); kept 'Trial's chip' to match source. Possessive format chosen; no prior translated chip lines to match.
'Oboete yagare' (stock villain parting line) rendered 'You'll pay for this!!' rather than literal 'Remember this'.
Term 'chuukei chiten' (dungeon heal/save/warp points) rendered 'checkpoints'. Not in glossary; system slices use the same term (tutorial title) and should match.
Nu Gundam asks OOO whether he knows W; 'him' used since W (Shotaro/Philip) is male per glossary.
No speaker recovered; content (self-introduction as Nu Gundam) settles it. #0.9 likewise Zero.
Dropped the furigana gloss for Fuuto.
Added the gloss 'Wind City' so 'true to its name' makes sense to English readers (the name is written with the kanji for wind + city).
'The other two' = Zero and OOO, Nu Gundam's party members.
Zero answering for himself and OOO; 'You bet we are!!' (source just 'Of course!!').
Philip; source ends with a playful question mark, rendered as a mannered declarative.
Zero; subject of 'don't know' unstated in source, rendered 'I' (could be 'we'). #0.44 repeats his intro (likely another branch).
Ankh bossy: 'We're gonna walk around' keeps the volitional command tone.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Unlabelled rows 0165 #0.8/#0.9 inferred from self-introductions (Nu Gundam, Zero). 0148 #0.10 source typo read as 'unfamiliar'. Terms not in glossary: 'chip' (character chips), 'checkpoint' (chuukei chiten), 'Camp Menu', 'Wind City' gloss for Fuuto. 'Trial's chip' kept literal (Accel Trial?).
